content:
**Silt Bean Puree** is a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

A creamy soup made from Tatoes, spices, and silt beans, crushed into an edible substance.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Boiled Water (2) Silt Bean (2) Spices (1) Tato (2) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned from plan/recipe Recipe: Silt Bean Puree | | Silt Bean Puree (1) | 

- Can be crafted at a Cooking Station once the Recipe has been learned.
- May be sold by Yasmin Chowdhury.
- Can be found in the Communist Collectron Station, when it is set to run in "Proletariat" mode.
